title: Siemens Healthineers doubles down on cardiovascular care as it exits general imaging ultrasound business - Cardiovascular Business

triage.summary: Siemens Healthineers is exiting the general imaging ultrasound business and redirecting investment toward cardiovascular care and procedural ultrasound (Cardiovascular Business, 2026-10-12).
triage.why_it_matters: Signals Siemens concentrating resources on cardiology, where it already has coronary CT analysis software. Worth watching for cardiac AI acquisitions or partnerships.
